contexts.text: The father of the dweller in tents and of cattle () = celestial things, because they = the holy things of love, and the goods thence derived. AC 415, Explained, Illustrated.
Under Abraham, see this reference.
Under Shepherd, see this reference.

The reason acquisition = truth... is that in the Original Language acquisition is a word which also means cattle in general, by which specifically are signified truths, when goods are signified by flocks...
Cattle () = those who are in good and truth.

They took their cattle () = the goods of truth. Cattle = the good of truth; for by cattle are meant both flocks and herds, and also horses, camels, mules, donkeys; and as, in the inward sense, flocks = interior goods, and herds, exterior goods, but horses, camels, mules, and donkeys, those things which belong to the Intellectual, which all relate to truths, cattle = the good of truth. AC 6049.
For they are men of cattle () = that they have good from truths. Cattle = the good of truth, or good from truths.

Ye shall say, Thy servants have been men of cattle from our childhood and even now () = that they have had truths from which comes good from the beginning, and still have them. Men of cattle = truths from which comes good. Explained, Illustrated.
Under Acquisition, see this reference.
Under Cattle, see this reference.

Thou shalt set them princes of the cattle upon which is to me () = that they are the primary things of scientifics... Cattle = the truths from which comes good; here, the scientifics in which these truths are, because it is said over that cattle which is to me, namely, to Pharaoh, by whom is not represented the truths in which there is good, but the scientifics in which are those truths.
Give your cattle, and I will give you for your cattle () = that they should offer goods of truth, and they would be supported. Cattle = the goods of truth. AC 6123. AC 6128.
For the cattle of the flock, and for the cattle of the herd () = the interior and exterior goods of truth... Cattle = the good of truth. AC 6134.

Behold, the hand of Jehovah shall be upon thy cattle which is in the field () = the vastation of the truth and good of faith which they had from the Church in which they had been... Cattle = the truths and goods of faith.

Jehovah shall distinguish between the cattle of Israel, and between the cattle of the Egyptians () = the difference between the truths and goods of faith of those who are of the spiritual Church, and the truths and goods of faith of those who are infesting... Cattle = the truths and goods of faith.
And now send and gather thy cattle () = that the truth of good is to be gathered... Cattle = the good of truth, and also the truth of good. References.
Our cattle also shall go with us () = that from the good of truth there shall be worship. Cattle = the good of truth.

To cause me to die, and my sons, and cattle, of thirst () = that from deficiency of truth everything of spiritual life will expire... Sons = interior truths of faith; cattle, exterior truths from which comes good.

Cattle () = goods of love; rams, goods of charity; he-goats, goods of faith. In the Word, there are mentioned flocks, cattle, and cattle, which in the Original Language are distinguished by their own names; and by flocks are signified internal things in general; by cattle, the same in special; and by cattle, inmost things in special; but by herds, external things. Illustrated.
Cattle = the goods and truths with man, for cattle of every kind correspond to affections such as belong to man.
The flocks of Arabia () = the Knowledges of truth and of good. ( = external goods. AE 391:9).
Cattle () = the Knowledges of good and truth.
Beasts and cattle () = evil affections, or cupidities originating from evil love.
Cattle () = goods and truths with man.
